_comment: Copy this file to api_keys.json and fill in what you actually use. Every key is optional except gemini_api_key; unset keys fall back to sane defaults or simply disable that feature with a clear error message.
_comment_llm: Local brain / tool-calling backend (core/llm_client.py). llm_provider: 'ollama' (native /api/chat) or 'openai' (any OpenAI-compatible server: LM Studio, Jan, LocalAI, llama.cpp server, vLLM).
_comment_local_ai_tool: Used by actions/local_ai.py (the run_local_model tool) — can be the same servers as above or different ones.
_comment_media: actions/media_server.py — Plex: Settings > Network > shows your token, or see https://support.plex.tv/articles/204059436. Jellyfin: Dashboard > API Keys.
_comment_game_servers: actions/game_server.py — one entry per dedicated server you want start/stop/status/list for. 'path' is the launch script/executable, 'cwd' its working directory, 'process_name' is optional (defaults to the executable's filename) and is what stop/status match against.
_comment_home_assistant: actions/game_server.py ha_call/ha_state — Home Assistant > Profile > Long-Lived Access Tokens.
_comment_daw: actions/audio_daw.py — install a virtual MIDI port (e.g. loopMIDI on Windows) so Jarvis and your DAW share one, and point the DAW's OSC listener at osc_host/osc_port.
_comment_render: actions/render_jobs.py — only needed if Blender isn't already on PATH.
_comment_vm: actions/vm_control.py — VirtualBox and Hyper-V are auto-detected via PATH/PowerShell; vmrun_path is only needed if VMware's vmrun isn't on PATH.
